name: Replicate
summary: Replicate runs thousands of open-source and hosted models, for text, images, video and speech, behind one API.

free_plan_covers.note: Only a trial: select models can be run for free for a while, then Replicate asks you to set up billing.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan; you pay for what you use, billed by hardware time or by input and output tokens depending on the model.

portability.note: Uses its own predictions API and client libraries rather than a common request format, though many of its models are open and can be run elsewhere.

free_tier.note: No ongoing free tier; free runs on select models are a trial before billing must be set up.

sdk_typescript.note: Official JavaScript client is published as the "replicate" npm package.

setup.step: Create a Replicate account and set up billing; free runs on select models only last a short while.
Create an API token and set it as an environment variable.
Install the client with npm install replicate.
Import Replicate and call replicate.run with a model name from a server route.

builder_notes: Keep REPLICATE_API_TOKEN on the server only; never call Replicate from client-side code.
Check each model's page for its price: some bill per token and others per second of hardware time.
Replicate is strongest for image, video and speech models; compare token prices before using it for plain chat.
